title: Farm records
limitations: A farmer-reviewed evidence summary, not a national filing form or a legal compliance decision.

title: Inspection evidence
limitations: Select evidence requested by the inspector. This summary does not establish inspection compliance or submit a response.

title: Aid application evidence
limitations: A supporting evidence dossier for farmer/adviser review. It is not the selected authority's application form, eligibility decision, or filing.
The farmer chooses and confirms the facts, activities and supporting documents. No national mandatory fields or accepted import schema are implied.

title: Inputs and treatment evidence
limitations: Review actual purchase and use records with their source units, dates and identifiers. Purchase evidence is not proof of use; missing historical treatments are not generated.
The farmer chooses and confirms the facts, activities and supporting documents. No national mandatory fields or accepted import schema are implied.

title: Environmental and scheme evidence
limitations: An evidence folder for the named scheme or request. It does not certify performance, scheme eligibility, or legal compliance.
The farmer chooses and confirms the facts, activities and supporting documents. No national mandatory fields or accepted import schema are implied.
